week ending October 26, 2023 = highest weekly MORTGAGE30US value of October 2023 (7.79%); the last earlier week with a value >= 7.79% is the week ending November 10, 2000 (7.79%, equal), the last earlier week strictly above it is the week ending October 20, 2000 (7.83%); no week from November 17, 2000 to October 19, 2023 reached 7.79%. "Highest since 2000" = the highest weekly value since the week ending November 10, 2000 (tied with that week; above every week since November 17, 2000). Monthly means agree: October 2023 (7.62%) is the highest monthly mean since November 2000 (7.745%). Search window: whole series from 2000-01-01.
